author: Müller, 1836

note.en: A cownose ray that looks nearly the same as R. bonasus; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica, but it cannot be told from the other cownose ray in the water and there is no local record.
note.es: Una raya gavilán que se ve casi igual que R. bonasus; FishBase la lista para Costa Rica, pero no se puede distinguir de la otra raya gavilán en el agua y no hay registros locales.

evidence: No local record found; FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic (coast not stated)
Bocas del Toro: 1 iNaturalist record identified only to Rhinoptera

sources.t: IUCN Red List: Rhinoptera brasiliensis, Vulnerable
